temporal_semantics.meaning: Collectable unlock/lock, rare-map writes, ammunition mutation, and ProcessCost are synchronous: stores/returns occur in the call body.
First rare discovery emits 0x06779f04 immediately after the map value becomes 1; SetRareAsFound has no timer.
Ammunition changes immediately at call time; AddAmmo clamps only above max and ConsumeAmmo has no body-level lower clamp.
ProcessCost reads current relative values and returns a derived cost in the same call; no balance update occurs in that body.
Only Active missions receive Update; elapsed time advances and duration can cause failure. Exact frame units/body ordering are unresolved.
NPC stores have a lifetime and dirty flag; store-screen entry requests generation, but expiry/refresh writers are unresolved.
Civilization income, city building update, population timers, tribe plans, and commodity depletion have no recovered cadence or writer contract.
